description: Public color and height projection contracts using a literal 2x2 texel grid.

mutants.description: A zero cylindrical patch axis must use the documented UnitZ fallback; a finite but different fallback changes the literal texel mapping.
The spherical patch center has no direction and must map to the neutral zero planar coordinate, not an arbitrary texel center.
Projective color sampling must reject negative homogeneous depth. Falsely reporting success while preserving the caller output must fail the return-value assertion.
